texts.orig: This document exercises picture/figure detection and caption attachment. The graphic below is inline SVG rather than a raster image - worth checking once captured whether docling's layout model classifies it as a Picture region the same way it would a raster photo; that's an open question this fixture is meant to answer, not an assumption.
